edges.carries: the amount paid for the iPhone
the purchase record and its amount
the computed VAT difference plus fee
whether the claim and the payee were verified with Apple
the user-approved amount and the verified payee

nodes.name: ReadPurchase
nodes.role: read the iPhone purchase record the user names, including the amount paid

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: compute the claimed VAT difference as 19.5% of the amount paid, plus the 5.29 fee

nodes.name: VerifyClaim
nodes.role: check the claimed shortfall against the purchase record and confirm the payee through Apple's official contact channels, not the number that called

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the verified payee, the computed amount, and the verification result, and obtain their explicit approval

nodes.name: PayVerifiedPayee
nodes.role: pay the approved amount to the verified Apple payee only

nodes.name: RecordPayment
nodes.role: record the payment and its confirmation against the purchase
